comment: M3 task 3 frozen render-check expectations (iter 44). The threshold
was seeded at 0.90 BEFORE the first pass, then RAISED to the
measured floor per the pre-registered freeze procedure
(docs/AGENT-LOG.md iter 44): first honest run measured min IoU
0.9149 (f1237, first-DEAD frame) / max 0.9302 over all 16 sampled
frames; frozen at floor(min*100)/100 = 0.91. NEVER loosened
(CLAUDE.md hard rule 3; PROCESS.md section 8). Residual mismatch is
characterized: browser-only boundary cells from 1-canvas-px stage
lines straddling 5x5 downscale cell boundaries + silhouette
perimeter AA noise; C-only cells measured ZERO on f0900 (the C
render never inks where the browser did not).
Sampled-frame selection (pre-registered procedure, resolved from
the g01 replay's actionStatesSeen coverage + fills): 30 ENTRANCE,
100 post-GO neutral, 170 first fox laser live (NEUTRALSPECIALGROUND
first seen 161), 971 first GUARD (shield disc), 1234 KO flight
(miniView bubble live), 1237 first DEAD* (dead players not drawn),
1297 first REBIRTH (halo), 2552 first DAMAGE*, plus even fills
Methodology pins (iou.js implements these; changing any is a
methodology change and requires re-freezing BEFORE judgment, never
after): browser mask = fg1|fg2 alpha>0 at 1200x750, downscaled 5x5
any-ink to 240x150; C mask = the rasterizer ink plane (PGM) in the
letterbox band rows [45,195), zero C ink allowed outside; retarget
k=0.2 dy=45; IoU >= iouThreshold per frame.
Review-44 hardening pins (iter 46): sampledFrameCount pins the
corpus size (check-render.sh/iou.js/capture-canvas.js assert the
list is exactly this many UNIQUE frames — changing the corpus is a
reviewed change to this file AND both twin code pins).
servedDistSha256 = sha256 over the sorted (urlPath, sha256-of-bytes-
as-served) list of every file the capture's HTTP server sent (incl.
the __wpCache-hooked main.js as served); measured from a fresh
capture of the pinned upstream build (27af171 + the committed
oracle/build-upstream.sh recipe), then frozen — a legitimate clone
rebuild that changes it requires a REVIEWED update here.
consoleErrorAllowlist: the ONLY page console.error messages the
capture tolerates (fail-closed otherwise). Entries cite CLAUDE.md's
expected-upstream-noise note (favicon.ico 404; webpack localforage
warning) plus the capture's OWN deliberate sfx/music route aborts
(capture-canvas.js context.route abort — audio is out of render
scope). Matching: text substring + optional location-url substring.
